IN PHOTOS │Activists from Salinlahi, GABRIELA, and allied groups held a candle-lighting protest at Boy Scout Circle on Jan. 9, 2026, demanding justice for three Mangyan-Irayan children and two young researchers killed in alleged AFP airstrikes in Abra de Ilog. The groups also called for the safe and immediate return of Chantal Anicoche, denouncing what they described as the military’s escalating attacks on indigenous communities, driven by corporate interests and the U.S.-backed "peace and security" program.

📸: Edd Castro

data.text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY FOR BRASS BAND COMPETITION, SINULOG SA DAKBAYAN STREET DANCING 

LOOK: The Cebu City Transportation Office (CCTO) has issued a traffic advisory ahead of the Brass Band Competition and the Sinulog sa Dakbayan Parade scheduled on Saturday, January 10, as part of the Sinulog 2026 celebration. 

The Brass Band Competition will start at 1:00 p.m., traversing from Fuente Osmeña Rotunda to the Cebu City Sports Center, while the Sinulog sa Dakbayan Parade will begin at 2:00 p.m. from the Basilica Minore del Sto. Niño and end at the same venue.

CCTO said multiple road closures will be implemented near the Basilica once the parade starts, while an open-and-close traffic scheme will be enforced along Colon Street until the contingents reach CCSC. Motorists are advised to take alternative routes as traffic personnel will be deployed to manage traffic flow. | via Lyle Andales #CDNDigital 
 
 📸: CCTO
